violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Large ice machine had debris buildup on splash guard. Detail clean more regularly.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Exposed studs, joists or rafters were not covered with smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable material. Dry storage room had exposed studs and rafters. some ceiling coverings present but were unapproved acoustic tile. Walls and ceilings need to be covered with smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surfaces.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Large ice machine in storage room in need of cleaning. Collecting buildup on splash guard.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Filters/Vents in need of cleaning. Collecting grease/dust buildup.
